messages:
lee: Heads up — spotted duplicate resources from the async Python client when our sample app hit a read timeout then retried. Seems common when backend finally returns 201 after client timed out.

lee: Short repro (async):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(token="$REDWOOD", timeout=1.0)  # small read timeout
    await c.post('/resources', json={"name": "test"})
```

lee: Behavior: client raises Timeout, retry layer retries POST, server processes original then responds 201 -> two resources. No idempotency header used in sample.

anya: I ran this with a recorder — same. We currently treat read timeouts as retriable and our transport will reserialize small json bodies, so POSTs get replayed. For streamed bodies it's a bigger problem (can't rewind).

devon: Proposal: conservative defaults. Only auto-retry safe methods (GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE) by default. For POSTs require an explicit idempotency key or explicit allow_replay flag.

priya: +1. UX idea: provide an opt-in middleware that signs/generates a UUID idempotency key per logical operation and exposes a typed helper, e.g. IdempotencyKey = NewType('IdempotencyKey', str). Sample API:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient, IdempotencyGenerator
client = AsyncClient(...)
key = IdempotencyGenerator.v4()  # typed str
await client.post('/resources', json=body, idempotency_key=key)
```

anya: Implementation detail: infra should honor "Idempotency-Key" header and perform dedupe for dedicated customers. We'll need docs for SLA/TTL semantics (how long to dedupe).

lee: Also want clearer retry config surface in quickstart, and mention which timeout class (connect vs read) is retried. Suggest default: retry on connection errors and 5xx; do not retry read timeouts for non-idempotent methods.

devon: Backoff: we should enable decorrelated jitter by default, and expose RetryPolicy(max_attempts=3, backoff='decorrelated_jitter'). Example:
```py
client = AsyncClient(..., retry_policy=RetryPolicy(max_attempts=3, backoff='jitter', retry_methods=('GET','PUT')))
```

priya: Tests: add an integration that delays the backend response beyond client timeout then returns 201 and assert only one resource exists. Also include a case with stream body that asserts we fail fast instead of silently replaying.

ci-bot: Created issue #2219: "python-async: safer POST retry defaults + idempotency helper + docs" assigned to @lee (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2219).

lee: I'll draft a short RFC + update the example app to show the idempotency helper and the new retry config. Thanks for the quick input :thumbsup:
